expressionProfile.sectionDescription: How this account speaks, who it speaks to, and how much time there is each week. Any item may stay pending — pending is not an error.
expressionProfile.neutralOnHint: There is no confirmed style sample, so this account writes in a neutral voice and says so on the draft. It does not stop material being recorded or written by hand.
expressionProfile.neutralOff: Writes from the confirmed style samples
expressionProfile.extractUnavailable: Not available yet (executors disabled, arriving with EP-08)

contentTopics.title: Topics
contentTopics.description: Manually written topic cards for this brand, and the frozen briefs their work starts from.
contentTopics.empty: No topic cards yet. Write one below to record who it is for and what it decides.
contentTopics.createDescription: Seven items, from docs/01 §5.2. Writing “none” is a complete answer — leaving a box empty is not.
contentTopics.firstRevision: The version this card started with

fields.audienceProblemJudgment: Who it is for, the problem, the judgement

placeholders.audienceProblemJudgment: Who reads it, what it solves, what it claims
placeholders.ipFit: Why this IP is the one to say it — or that it is not a fit

placeholders.existingContentRelation: What it follows on from, or “no existing work”
placeholders.evidenceGapsAndInvestment: What evidence is missing and what it will take
placeholders.recommendedAction: Start, save, defer or drop — and why

contentTopics.decisionDescription: Start creates the first frozen brief. Starting again keeps the same first version.
contentTopics.decisionReasonHint: Kept for defer and drop; a start or a save does not store it.
contentTopics.decisionNotePlaceholder: Anything the reason does not say
contentTopics.briefDescription: Versions are appended, never edited. Open one to read what it said.
contentTopics.briefReadOnly: Read-only — a change is saved as a new version.
contentTopics.appendDescription: Eleven items, from docs/01 §5.3. Saving appends a version and leaves the older ones as they are.
contentTopics.appendHint: Available once something differs from the latest version.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.description: Later cards in this series. Named here so “not built” does not read as “broken”.

contentTopics.accountHint: Optional. A card written for one account can say why it fits that account.
